text:
Zara (People Ops): kicking off Q3 "Thank & Thrive" recognition — combo of a $20 digital voucher + optional desk plant drop for local hubs. need alignment on nomination flow, tax-safe messaging, PO/GL, and courier rules. quick thoughts?
Ken (Logistics): optional plant is nice but customs/soil regs vary. recommended: physical plants only for US/CAN/UK offices; international folks get a second e-voucher.
Olivia (HRBP): manager approval required. propose: managers get a compact list (name + 1-line praise) and a one-click approve/decline. deadline 2 business days before vendor delivery.
Marco (Finance): budget: use GL-6130 (Employee recognition). vouchers via vendor = non-payroll; physical plants with cash-equivalent addons might trigger payroll in some countries. need country tax checklist.
Talia (Benefits): steuer note: keep packaging free of amounts. e-voucher email will state value and tax FAQ link. For countries with mandatory reporting, benefits team will flag recipients to trigger payroll routing.
Roux (Vendor Liaison): vendor can deliver e-vouchers instantly and coordinate plant drops in approved regions. PO required 10 business days before ship. turnaround for plants is ~7 business days after PO.
Zara (People Ops): timeline draft: nom open Jul 1-12; manager approvals due Jul 14; shipping opt-in + address verification Jul 16; PO cut Jul 18; sends week of Jul 29.
Ken (Logistics): signature policy: signature required only for plant drops; e-vouchers no signature. Ken: will create a country exclusion list for live plants by EOD Fri.
Olivia (HRBP): wording for manager comms: short script + approval buttons. include explicit line: "If recipient selects cash payout, it must be processed via payroll (see deadline Jul 12)."
Marco (Finance): note payroll cutoff for cash payouts: Jul 12 to hit payroll Jul 28. for any cash requests after that, next cycle.
Talia (Benefits): action: I'll produce a one-page tax FAQ (global) to include in the e-card and internal comms.
Roux (Vendor Liaison): will confirm PO template and unit pricing; can we set a 5% contingency for damaged plants?
Zara (People Ops): yes add 5% buffer. action items: 1) Ken: plant-allowed-country list + signature rules (due Fri). 2) Roux: vendor PO template + pricing + SLA (due Tue). 3) Talia: global tax FAQ copy (due Mon). 4) Marco: confirm GL-6130 and reserve budget (due Tue). 5) Olivia: manager approval flow + comm script (due Mon).
Olivia (HRBP): I'll also include an optional manager note template to help write the 1-line praise.
Ken (Logistics): small practical: please include preferred delivery weekdays per region to avoid weekend returns.
Zara (People Ops): good point. we'll default to Tue-Thu deliveries.
Marco (Finance): once PO is ready, I'll route for approval. prefer net-30 payment terms.
Roux (Vendor Liaison): vendor OK with net-30 for our account. will draft PO accordingly.
Zara (People Ops): perfect. i'll put a short tracker in the shared drive and ping here with the nomination link when ready. any objections?
Olivia (HRBP): none. :thumbsup:
Talia (Benefits): none from me.
Ken (Logistics): no objections. will post country list soon.
Roux (Vendor Liaison): all good.
Zara (People Ops): thanks team — i'll lock timelines and post manager comms draft by EOD Mon. :seedling::sparkles:
